input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The Agreement has no post-termination transition assistance or data-return provision. Article XXI (Effect of Termination) runs entirely in Licensor's favour: our licence terminates automatically and we must ship back all Licensed Technology and Confidential Information within five days and certify compliance, while all Licensor rights survive. Nothing requires Licensor — which hosts our market data, order and trade records on its platform — to return our data, provide wind-down help, or delete our data afterwards. The confidentiality article (p0124) binds only Licensee, and Articles XIX–XXIII contain no exit mechanics. For a hosted trading platform this absence is a deviation; we inserted a new Article XXI-A giving six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter, with a 90-day fallback offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations after Article XXI (Effect of Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI requires us to return everything on termination but gives us no exit rights, so we have added a reciprocal wind-down provision: up to six months of transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: ARTICLE XXI-A TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (a) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. For purposes of this Article, "Licensee Data" means all data, records and information of Licensee or its customers, including trade, order and transaction records, that is submitted to, hosted, processed or stored by Licensor in connection with this Agreement.
